plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a man named Ted Owens, who claimed to have unusual powers. Mishlove says that in the 1970s and 1980s Owens asked owners of major league sports teams in the United States to pay him to protect their teams. According to Mishlove, when owners backed out of their promise, in at least one case a suicide followed.
